remarks: Beautifully renovated and impeccably decorated 3 bed, 2 bath condo located on the border of Westport and Norwalk in the desirable Birchwood complex. Set at the highest point in the community, this unit offers peaceful treetop views with a glimpse of the water in the distance, a rare and special setting! This spacious home lives entirely on one level and features gleaming hardwood floors, a cozy wood-burning fireplace, and new Andersen windows that flood the space with natural light. The open concept living and dining areas flow effortlessly to a private balcony, perfect for morning coffee or evening relaxation. The updated kitchen and baths are move-in ready, while 3 generously sized bedrooms offer comfort and flexibility. Additional highlights include an attached one-car garage, private storage space, and access to the community pool. Unbeatable location: Walk to Whole Foods, enjoy quick access to downtown Westport, and benefit from an easy commute via nearby train and highways. A rare opportunity to enjoy low-maintenance, stylish living in one of Fairfield County's most convenient and connected areas.
